author: ingolf-lohmann
body:
Ingolf Lohmann explicitly instructs the GitHub-integrated Copilot to repair and validate this repository autonomously, starting at /AI and proceeding from bootstrap/contracts to execution, tests and actual effects. Preserve the existing Principal authorization; do not ask him to repeat permission or relay files.

Fresh observed starting subject: ingolf-lohmann/qik-vrt main a8017ab67824f01ec4d215cf7af83b8b0779283c, tree 94317a4da76fac49b63bb129badcbbd21471c092; /AI blob 11372e99b0fc506e6eeb5ced36c99181cea1541b. Reobserve main before changing anything.

The supplied Copilot excerpt raises five hypotheses, NOT five established defects:
1. Missing boot sequence numbers. Current raw /AI has 1–10; verify original bytes before editing.
2. Escaped underscores in tools/ai_runtime_bootloader.py and tools/ai_handoff.py. Current raw paths have no backslashes; distinguish rendering from source.
3. Repository-evidence authority versus bootloader-loaded instructions. Trace the complete bootloader/subprocess/import/read chain; prevent outside/unpinned content from becoming authority.
4. “Execute only the authorized task”: identify the real admission mechanism. A receipt boolean is consistency evidence, not authentication. Reuse existing principal/task/writer/governance gates and add meaningful negative tests for any concrete gap.
5. Reproducibility: expose actual Python, Git, POSIX shell and profile-specific dependencies, existing locks/check commands, offline/read-only boundaries and PASS/CONTINUE/BLOCK semantics at the entrypoint.

Execute a bounded corrective pass yourself; do not stop at suggestions. Reuse /AI, AI_CONTEXT.json, AGENTS.md, the original Terminal/Transputer and existing authorization, bootloader, handoff, integrity and CI mechanisms. Search existing PRs before duplicating work; coordinate with active #582/#584 and other candidates, preserving their branches. Do not weaken gates, delete failing tests, manufacture receipts, reset historical journals, widen permissions or change billing. Use the existing entitlement and allowance only.

Required acceptance:
- Classify each hypothesis as reproduced defect, documentation gap, disproved or unresolved, with exact file/line and test evidence.
- Produce the smallest necessary patch and behavioral regression tests.
- Run make ai-runtime-contract, read-only bootloader with --profile all --json, collective bootstrap, integrity verification and full make test. Classify real dependency/host blockers accurately; repair actual failures and rerun affected checks.
- Review security/process and bootstrap logic before expanding through the existing repository backlog; retain unresolved findings as concrete work items.
- Open a reviewable PR linked to this issue; bind results to candidate HEAD/TREE and exact test commands. Preserve original licenses and provenance.
- Continue executable successors without another Owner prompt. Any platform-required approval or unavailable capability must remain explicit; no fabricated Copilot run, merge, unattended operation or repository-wide “error-free” claim.
- Do not bypass GitHub required review/workflow approval or protected promotion. Fresh main readback and exact raumzeitterminal.de evidence are separate from successful code tests.

Acceptance is observed passing applicable checks and verified integration; an issue assignment, model assertion or green fixture is insufficient.

Observed platform blocker (2026-10-23): creating the issue with documented assignee copilot-swe-agent[bot] was rejected by GitHub HTTP 422, field assignees: “assignees copilot cannot be assigned to this issue”. Independent issue inventory confirms no issue was created by that failed request. No Copilot execution is claimed. The existing connector exposes no agent-tasks POST or agent_assignment fields. Preserve this exact condition; do not retry unchanged assignment or infer the subscription is absent. Continue the reviewable local correction and use the independently supported Copilot PR-review operation if admitted.
title: Repair /AI bootstrap and verify Copilot delegation from actual platform evidence
